head: a5b141816ffb871110e541ef00ecf9527674137e
summary: Synthetic volatile fixture tests confirmed a success-only stale route projection defect. Before correction, successful Session.logout after navigation reset foreign, captured readonly, and pending public-profile projections to unknown/null; failure controls and same-route logout behaved as expected. The bounded correction captures the session owner's profile id before logout, always anonymizes community on success, clears projection only when the current route is not a public profile or targets that owner profile, and retains the existing route-epoch login redirect. Foreign, captured, and pending public projections now survive successful logout while the provider session/community still become anonymous. Same-route logout clears own profile and redirects; logout failure preserves authenticated state, community role, and foreign projection. No authority broadening observed.
